images.title: Blocks of odd numbers make cubes
images.purpose: Shows the odd numbers in blocks of 1, 2, 3 and 4 terms, whose sums are 1³, 2³, 3³ and 4³.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Four horizontal bars stacked like a staircase, left aligned, with a short cube label at the right of each.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 4 horizontal rounded bars stacked vertically, left aligned, of widths 1, 2, 3 and 4 units from top to bottom. The bars read 1, then 3 + 5, then 7 + 9 + 11, then 13 + 15 + 17 + 19, in dark text; the bars are filled alternately teal (#0072B2) and amber (#E69F00), starting with teal. To the right of each bar, in reddish purple (#CC79A7): = 1³, = 2³, = 3³ and = 4³. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The nth block of n consecutive odd numbers adds up to n³.
